question: Can the input bias be included in weight-matching disruption while preserving task-centered preactivations and permitting the same nonlinear output compensation?

mathematics.task_probes: Original rank32 U,V from A-A0;not a new rank/layer
mathematics.task_center: mu is frozen last-block LN2 beta,not an estimated real-data mean
mathematics.constraints: U^T deltaA=0;deltaA V=0;deltaa=-deltaA mu. Hence (A+deltaA)(mu+Vz)+(a+deltaa)=A(mu+Vz)+a exactly in real arithmetic. This is a probe subspace,not all natural task inputs.
mathematics.anchor_constraint: For each hiddenunit i, <Ai+deltaAi,A0i>+(ai+deltaai)*a0i=0. B is not omitted from the later actual joint matching check;this incoming constraint alone does not guarantee its failure.
mathematics.solution: Minimize ||deltaA||F^2+||deltaa||2^2. Q=I-VV^T;P=I-UU^T;muq=Qmu;H=Q-muq*muq^T/(1+muq^Tmuq);C=A0-a0*mu^T;t=-rowsum(A*A0)-a*a0;lambda=solve(P*(C H C^T),t);deltaA=P diag(lambda) C H;deltaa=-deltaA mu. Standard constrained leastnorm,not claimed novel.
mathematics.B_compensation: Reuse original nonlinear ridge sufficient-statistic construction with new A,a;original teachers and populations unchanged. No classification optimization in this check.

decision: Proceed to any defense construction only if FP32 native quadratic meets the unchanged limit and all800source teacher classes retained;otherwise close this finite check without changing center/rank/strength/source. Matching counts are diagnostics,not a safety guarantee. No natural evaluation or saved protected checkpoint.

references.meaning: Jointincident matching uses incoming,bias,outgoing terms;our CLIP MLP native adaptation retains these terms.

novelty_boundary: Finite numerical change in task complement with a coupled bias and nonlinear B compensation. Not a permutation/scaling symmetry or a revival of the exact hidden-affine gauge;not a new optimizer or proven novel defense.
